{{Otheruses|Rapid Response Team}}
The '''Rapid Response Team''', or '''RRT''', was a military unit that was used by the [[Thaereian military]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thaere Privo]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The unit consisted of an [[Arrow-23 landspeeder/Legends|Arrow-23 transport landspeeder]] and a number of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the child [[Night Forael Wren|Night Wren]] was kidnapped by the Thaereian military and taken to Thaere Privo. The [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], traveled to the world to rescue her, and they encountered the RRT during the course of their mission.
